properties.name: manhattan_1836
properties.map: Topographical Map of the City and County of New-York, and the adjacent Country — J. H. Colton & Co., New York 1836 (engr. S. Stiles & Co.)
properties.georeferencing: georeferenced here: six points read by eye, then 60 control points found by matching the map's street strips to today's centrelines in 700 m windows (tools/autoalign.py; tools/gcps_own.json, colton1836), thin-plate spline; residual = cross-validated RMS
properties.note: Built-up = the parts of blocks Colton shades (unbuilt blocks and the unbuilt parts of a block are left white). Envelope = the map's bulkhead line, drawn about 30 m inside it (the water is ruled dark near the shore), so the outermost waterfront strip can be missing; the Battery, the Park and Tompkins Square (drawn with trees) are left out; the hachured grounds of Bellevue and Murray Hill were not read. Shaded pieces narrower than about 25 m are dropped.
properties.method: built blocks classified by tone on the warped map (tools/classify.py, parameters in tools/classify_runs.py), clipped to a hand-drawn envelope
